name: MarketplaceService
simple: MarketplaceService handles everything about spending Robux in your game: showing buy windows, checking if a player owns a game pass, and giving players what they paid for. It is how creators sell passes, developer products and subscriptions.
analogy: MarketplaceService is like the cash register at a shop. The customer (client) can say 'I want to buy this', and the register pops up the payment screen, but only the shop owner in the back (the server) hands over the item after the payment really goes through.
whenToUse: Show a purchase window for a game pass (one-time buy, like VIP) or a developer product (can be bought again, like 100 coins).
Check if a player owns a game pass when they join, and give them the perks.
Give players what they bought using `ProcessReceipt` or `BindReceiptHandler` on the server.
where: Get it with `game:GetService("MarketplaceService")`. Purchase prompts can be shown from a LocalScript or a server Script. Giving rewards (`ProcessReceipt`, `BindReceiptHandler`) and ownership checks for rewards must be done on the server.

terms.Robux: Roblox's money that players buy with real money.
terms.game pass (pass): Something a player buys once and owns forever in your game, like VIP or double speed.
terms.developer product: Something a player can buy again and again, like 100 coins or a revive.
terms.prompt: The pop-up window that asks the player to confirm a purchase.
terms.receipt: A record Roblox sends to your server saying 'this player paid for this product'. Your server must answer that it gave the item.
terms.subscription: Something a player pays for every month to keep getting benefits.
terms.bundle: A set of avatar items sold together, like a full character body.
terms.asset: Any item on Roblox with an ID, like a hat, shirt or gear.
terms.server: The Roblox computer in charge of one copy of your game. A popular game runs many servers at the same time, each with its own group of players.
terms.client: A player's own device (phone, PC, console). LocalScripts run there.
terms.callback: A function you hand to Roblox so Roblox can run it later, when something happens.
terms.pcall: Short for 'protected call'. It runs a function and catches errors instead of crashing your script. It returns `true` and the results if it worked, or `false` and the error message if it failed.
terms.async / yield: Functions ending in `Async` talk to other computers over the internet. Your script pauses (yields) until the answer comes back.
terms.exploiter: A cheater who changes their own client. They can fake events on their device, so only trust purchase results the server gets from Roblox.

examples.title: Sell 100 coins (developer product) safely
examples.code:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local COINS_100_PRODUCT_ID = 123456789 -- replace with your developer product id

-- Set ONE ProcessReceipt for your whole game, in one server Script
MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receiptInfo)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receiptInfo.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		-- They left. Roblox will try again next time they join.
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	if receiptInfo.ProductId == COINS_100_PRODUCT_ID then
		local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
		if coins then
			coins.Value += 100
			-- Only say Granted AFTER the player really got the item
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end

	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
end
explain: When someone buys a developer product, Roblox calls `ProcessReceipt` on the server with a receipt.
We find the player. If they already left, we say NotProcessedYet so Roblox tries again later.
We give the coins, then return PurchaseGranted. If we return that without giving the item, the player loses their Robux for nothing.
To show the buy window, a LocalScript can call `MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, COINS_100_PRODUCT_ID)`.
For real games, also save the coins (and the receipt's PurchaseId) to a data store so a purchase is never given twice or lost.

examples.title: VIP game pass: buy button and perk
examples.place: LocalScript inside a TextButton in StarterGui + Script in ServerScriptService
examples.code:
-- CLIENT: LocalScript inside a TextButton
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local VIP_PASS_ID = 987654 -- replace with your pass id

script.Parent.Activated:Connect(function()
	MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(Players.LocalPlayer, VIP_PASS_ID)
end)

-- SERVER: Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local VIP_PASS_ID = 987654

local function giveVip(player)
	player:SetAttribute("VIP", true)
end

-- Already owns it when joining?
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, owns = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, VIP_PASS_ID)
	end)
	if ok and owns then
		giveVip(player)
	end
end)

-- Bought it during this visit?
MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, wasPurchased)
	if wasPurchased and passId == VIP_PASS_ID then
		giveVip(player)
	end
end)
explain: The button only shows the buy window. It does not give anything.
The server checks ownership with `UserOwnsGamePassAsync` when the player joins.
The server also listens for `PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished` to give VIP right after buying.
The perk is given by the server, so a cheater cannot just give themselves VIP.

gotchas: Never give paid items from a LocalScript or because a client said so. Give them on the server.
Set `ProcessReceipt` only once in one server Script. Setting it in two scripts means one replaces the other.
Do not use `PromptProductPurchaseFinished` to give developer products; use `ProcessReceipt` or `BindReceiptHandler`.
Game pass IDs and developer product IDs are different from asset IDs. Use the right one for each function.
Calls ending in Async can fail; wrap them in pcall.
You cannot test real Robux spending in Studio; Studio purchases are fake test purchases.

MarketplaceService:BindReceiptHandler.simple: The newer way to handle purchases on the server. You pick a receipt type (developer products, or Robux transfers) and give a function. It can also take a list of product IDs so different products go to different functions. Your function must return `Enum.ReceiptDecision.Processed` once the item is given, or `NotProcessedYet` to try again later.
MarketplaceService:BindReceiptHandler.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local REVIVE_ID = 111111 -- your developer product id

MarketplaceService:BindReceiptHandler(Enum.ReceiptType.DeveloperProduct, function(receipt)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ReceiptDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	player:LoadCharacter() -- revive them
	return Enum.ReceiptDecision.Processed
end, { REVIVE_ID }) -- only handle this product here
MarketplaceService:BindReceiptHandler.gotcha: Only one handler can exist for the same type and product. If no handler matches, the old `ProcessReceipt` is used.

MarketplaceService:GetDeveloperProductsA.simple: Gets a list (in pages) of all developer products in your game, so you can build a shop menu without typing every product in by hand.
MarketplaceService:GetDeveloperProductsA.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local ok, pages = pcall(function()
	return MarketplaceService:GetDeveloperProductsAsync()
end)
if ok then
	for _, product in pages:GetCurrentPage() do
		print(product) -- a table of info about each product
	end
end

MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync.simple: Gets details about an item, game pass or developer product: its name, description, price and more. Tell it what kind of thing it is with an `Enum.InfoType`.
MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync.example:
-- Script or LocalScript
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local VIP_PASS_ID = 987654

local ok, info = pcall(function()
	return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync(VIP_PASS_ID, Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
end)
if ok then
	print(info.Name, info.PriceInRobux)
end
MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync.gotcha: It errors if the ID does not exist, so use pcall.

MarketplaceService:GetRobloxSubscription.simple: Checks if a player has Roblox's own platform-wide subscription. You get a table with `IsSubscribed` and `IsOriginExperience` (true if they first subscribed inside your game).
MarketplaceService:GetRobloxSubscription.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, details = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:GetRobloxSubscriptionDetailsAsync(player)
	end)
	if ok and details.IsSubscribed then
		print(player.Name .. " is a subscriber!")
	end
end)

MarketplaceService:GetSubscriptionProduc.simple: Gets details about one of your game's subscriptions, like its name, description and display price, using its subscription ID (a string).
MarketplaceService:GetSubscriptionProduc.example:
-- Script or LocalScript
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local ok, info = pcall(function()
	return MarketplaceService:GetSubscriptionProductInfoAsync("EXP-1234567890")
end)
if ok then
	print(info.Name, info.DisplayPrice)
end

MarketplaceService:GetUsersPriceLevelsAs.simple: Gets a suggested price level for each player, based on their country and how much things cost there. A price level of 100 means about 100 Robux is a fair price for that player. Helps you keep trades and gifts fair.
MarketplaceService:GetUsersPriceLevelsAs.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, levels = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:GetUsersPriceLevelsAsync({ player.UserId })
	end)
	if ok then
		print(levels) -- shows each user id with its price level
	end
end)

MarketplaceService:GetUserSubscriptionDe.simple: Gets more detail about a player's subscription: its state, when it renews next and when it expires.
MarketplaceService:GetUserSubscriptionDe.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, details = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:GetUserSubscriptionDetailsAsync(player, "EXP-1234567890")
	end)
	if ok then
		print(details.SubscriptionState, details.NextRenewTime)
	end
end)

MarketplaceService:GetUserSubscriptionPa.simple: Gets up to one year of a player's payments for a subscription. Each entry says the time period and whether it was paid or refunded.
MarketplaceService:GetUserSubscriptionPa.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local function showHistory(player)
	local ok, history = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:GetUserSubscriptionPaymentHistoryAsync(player, "EXP-1234567890")
	end)
	if ok then
		for _, payment in history do
			print(payment.CycleStartTime, payment.PaymentStatus)
		end
	end
end

MarketplaceService:GetUserSubscriptionSt.simple: Checks if a player is subscribed right now. Returns a table with `IsSubscribed` (active?) and `IsRenewing` (will it continue next period?).
MarketplaceService:GetUserSubscriptionSt.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SUB_ID = "EXP-1234567890" -- your subscription id

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, status = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:GetUserSubscriptionStatusAsync(player, SUB_ID)
	end)
	if ok and status.IsSubscribed then
		player:SetAttribute("Subscriber", true)
	end
end)

MarketplaceService:OpenShop.simple: Opens Roblox's built-in in-game Shop window for a player, showing your game passes and developer products sorted for them. No setup needed.
MarketplaceService:OpenShop.example:
-- LocalScript inside a TextButton in StarterGui
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

script.Parent.Activated:Connect(function()
	MarketplaceService:OpenShop(Players.LocalPlayer)
end)
MarketplaceService:OpenShop.gotcha: From a LocalScript, the player must be the local player.

MarketplaceService:PlayerOwnsAssetAsync.simple: Checks if a player has an item (like a hat or gear) in their inventory, using its asset ID.
MarketplaceService:PlayerOwnsAssetAsync.gotcha: Do not use it for game passes (use `UserOwnsGamePassAsync`) or developer products (players do not 'own' those).

MarketplaceService:PlayerOwnsBundleAsync.simple: Checks if a player owns a bundle (a set of avatar items), using its bundle ID.
MarketplaceService:PlayerOwnsBundleAsync.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local function ownsBundle(player, bundleId)
	local ok, owns = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:PlayerOwnsBundleAsync(player, bundleId)
	end)
	return ok and owns
end

MarketplaceService:PromptBulkPurchase.simple: Server only. Shows one buy window for several avatar items or bundles at once (up to 20), like a 'buy the whole outfit' button.
MarketplaceService:PromptBulkPurchase.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local function buyOutfit(player)
	local items = {
		{ Type = Enum.MarketplaceProductType.AvatarAsset, Id = "16630147" },
		{ Type = Enum.MarketplaceProductType.AvatarBundle, Id = "182" },
	}
	MarketplaceService:PromptBulkPurchase(player, items, {})
end
MarketplaceService:PromptBulkPurchase.gotcha: Only works with avatar items, and only from the server.

MarketplaceService:PromptBundlePurchase.simple: Shows a buy window for a bundle (a set of avatar items).
MarketplaceService:PromptBundlePurchase.example:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

MarketplaceService:PromptBundlePurchase(Players.LocalPlayer, 182)

MarketplaceService:PromptCancelSubscript.simple: Shows a window that lets a player cancel one of your game's subscriptions.
MarketplaceService:PromptCancelSubscript.example:
-- LocalScript inside a TextButton in StarterGui
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

script.Parent.Activated:Connect(function()
	MarketplaceService:PromptCancelSubscription(Players.LocalPlayer, "EXP-1234567890")
end)

MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchas.simple: Shows a buy window for a game pass. Use the pass ID (from the Creator Hub), not an asset ID.
MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchas.example:
-- LocalScript inside a TextButton in StarterGui
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

script.Parent.Activated:Connect(function()
	MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(Players.LocalPlayer, 987654)
end)
MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchas.gotcha: Showing the window gives nothing. The server gives the perk after checking ownership.

MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase.simple: Shows a buy window for a developer product (something you can buy many times, like coins). The item is given by your `ProcessReceipt` or `BindReceiptHandler` on the server.
MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase.example:
-- LocalScript inside a TextButton in StarterGui
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local COINS_100_PRODUCT_ID = 123456789

script.Parent.Activated:Connect(function()
	MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(Players.LocalPlayer, COINS_100_PRODUCT_ID)
end)

MarketplaceService:PromptPurchase.simple: Shows a buy window for an item from the Marketplace, like a hat or gear, using its asset ID.
MarketplaceService:PromptPurchase.example:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

MarketplaceService:PromptPurchase(Players.LocalPlayer, 1029025)
MarketplaceService:PromptPurchase.gotcha: For limited items, prompting from the server is recommended; from the client it shows the cheapest resale copy.

MarketplaceService:PromptRobloxSubscript.simple: Shows a window asking the player to buy Roblox's own subscription (Roblox Plus).
MarketplaceService:PromptRobloxSubscript.example:
-- LocalScript inside a TextButton in StarterGui
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

script.Parent.Activated:Connect(function()
	MarketplaceService:PromptRobloxSubscriptionPurchase(Players.LocalPlayer)
end)

MarketplaceService:PromptRobuxTransferAs.simple: Server only. Starts sending Robux from one player to another user (for example, a gift or a trade). Returns a transfer request ID. Both players later get a receipt through `BindReceiptHandler`.
MarketplaceService:PromptRobuxTransferAs.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local function giftRobux(sender, receiverUserId, amount)
	local ok, requestId = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:PromptRobuxTransferAsync(sender, receiverUserId, amount)
	end)
	if ok then
		print("Transfer started, id:", requestId)
	end
end
MarketplaceService:PromptRobuxTransferAs.gotcha: Amount and receiver ID must be positive whole numbers. Some transfers wait for approval (like parental consent) before they finish.

MarketplaceService:PromptSubscriptionPur.simple: Shows a buy window for one of your game's subscriptions, using its subscription ID (a string).
MarketplaceService:PromptSubscriptionPur.example:
-- LocalScript inside a TextButton in StarterGui
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

script.Parent.Activated:Connect(function()
	MarketplaceService:PromptSubscriptionPurchase(Players.LocalPlayer, "EXP-1234567890")
end)

MarketplaceService:RankProductsAsync.simple: Give it a list of your game passes and developer products (up to 50), and it sorts them in the order this player is most likely to want them. Handy for a personal shop.
MarketplaceService:RankProductsAsync.example:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local products = {
	{ InfoType = Enum.InfoType.GamePass, Id = 987654 },
	{ InfoType = Enum.InfoType.Product, Id = 123456789 },
}

local ok, ranked = pcall(function()
	return MarketplaceService:RankProductsAsync(products)
end)
if ok then
	for i, item in ranked do
		print(i, item.ProductInfo.Name)
	end
end
MarketplaceService:RankProductsAsync.gotcha: Limited to 10 calls per minute. If you go over, wait 60 seconds.

MarketplaceService:RecommendTopProductsA.simple: Gives up to 50 of your game passes and/or developer products that this player is most likely to buy. You choose which kinds with a list of `Enum.InfoType`.
MarketplaceService:RecommendTopProductsA.example:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local ok, items = pcall(function()
	return MarketplaceService:RecommendTopProductsAsync({ Enum.InfoType.GamePass, Enum.InfoType.Product })
end)
if ok then
	for _, item in items do
		print(item.ProductInfo.Name)
	end
end
MarketplaceService:RecommendTopProductsA.gotcha: Limited to 5 calls per minute. May return an empty list.

MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync.simple: Checks if a player (by UserId) owns a game pass. The usual way to give pass perks when a player joins.
MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SPEED_PASS_ID = 987654

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, owns = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, SPEED_PASS_ID)
	end)
	if ok and owns then
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			character:WaitForChild("Humanoid").WalkSpeed = 24
		end)
	end
end)
MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync.gotcha: Pass the pass ID, not an asset ID. Results may be cached for a short while.

MarketplaceService.PromptBulkPurchaseFin.simple: Fires when a bulk avatar-item buy window closes. Gives the player, a status and a results table.
MarketplaceService.PromptBulkPurchaseFin.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

MarketplaceService.PromptBulkPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, status, results)
	print(player.Name, "closed the bulk window:", status)
end)
MarketplaceService.PromptBulkPurchaseFin.gotcha: Not a trusted signal. To be sure they own the items, check with `PlayerOwnsAssetAsync` or `PlayerOwnsBundleAsync`.

MarketplaceService.PromptBundlePurchaseF.simple: Fires when a bundle buy window closes. Tells you the player, the bundle ID and whether they bought it.
MarketplaceService.PromptBundlePurchaseF.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

MarketplaceService.PromptBundlePurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, bundleId, wasPurchased)
	print(player.Name, bundleId, wasPurchased)
end)

MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchas.simple: Fires when a game pass buy window closes. Tells you the player, the pass ID and whether they bought it. Use it on the server to give the perk right away.
MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchas.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local VIP_PASS_ID = 987654

MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, wasPurchased)
	if wasPurchased and passId == VIP_PASS_ID then
		player:SetAttribute("VIP", true)
	end
end)

MarketplaceService.PromptPremiumPurchase.simple: Fires when the Roblox Premium buy window closes. It does not tell you whether they bought it.
MarketplaceService.PromptPremiumPurchase.example:
-- LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

MarketplaceService.PromptPremiumPurchaseFinished:Connect(function()
	print("Premium window closed")
end)
MarketplaceService.PromptPremiumPurchase.gotcha: To know if someone's membership changed, use `Players.PlayerMembershipChanged`.

MarketplaceService.PromptProductPurchase.simple: Fires when a developer product buy window closes. Gives the UserId, the product ID and whether it was bought. Good for things like closing your shop menu.
MarketplaceService.PromptProductPurchase.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

MarketplaceService.PromptProductPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(userId, productId, isPurchased)
	print(userId, productId, isPurchased)
end)
MarketplaceService.PromptProductPurchase.gotcha: Do NOT give the product here. Use `ProcessReceipt` or `BindReceiptHandler`, which are reliable.

MarketplaceService.PromptPurchaseFinishe.simple: Fires when a buy window for a Marketplace item (like a hat or gear) closes. Tells you the player, the asset ID and whether it was bought.
MarketplaceService.PromptPurchaseFinishe.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

MarketplaceService.PromptPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, assetId, isPurchased)
	if isPurchased then
		print(player.Name .. " bought asset " .. assetId)
	end
end)
MarketplaceService.PromptPurchaseFinishe.gotcha: Does not fire for developer products or game passes; they have their own events.

MarketplaceService.PromptRobloxSubscript.simple: Fires when the Roblox Plus buy window closes. Tells you the player and whether they tried to buy.
MarketplaceService.PromptRobloxSubscript.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

MarketplaceService.PromptRobloxSubscriptionPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(user, didTryPurchasing)
	print(user.Name, "tried to subscribe:", didTryPurchasing)
end)
MarketplaceService.PromptRobloxSubscript.gotcha: Trying is not the same as succeeding. Watch `Player.HasRobloxSubscription` on the server before giving rewards.

MarketplaceService.PromptSubscriptionPur.simple: Fires when one of your game's subscription buy windows closes. Tells you the player, the subscription ID and whether they tried to buy.
MarketplaceService.PromptSubscriptionPur.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

MarketplaceService.PromptSubscriptionPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(user, subscriptionId, didTryPurchasing)
	print(user.Name, subscriptionId, didTryPurchasing)
end)

MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt.simple: The function the server sets to hand out developer products. Roblox calls it with a receipt each time a purchase needs handling. Give the item, then return `Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted`. If you cannot give it yet, return `NotProcessedYet` and Roblox will try again later (for example, next time they join).
MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt.example:
-- Script in ServerScriptService
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local COINS_100_PRODUCT_ID = 123456789 -- replace with your developer product id

-- Set ONE ProcessReceipt for your whole game, in one server Script
MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receiptInfo)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receiptInfo.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		-- They left. Roblox will try again next time they join.
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	if receiptInfo.ProductId == COINS_100_PRODUCT_ID then
		local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
		if coins then
			coins.Value += 100
			-- Only say Granted AFTER the player really got the item
			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end

	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
end
MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt.gotcha: Set it only once, in one server Script. It might run twice for the same purchase, so save each receipt's PurchaseId in a data store and skip ones you already handled.
